terra.problem: “Amaziah Turns to False Gods” takes place after Amaziah returned from the battle, not at the Valley of Salt. The passage does not locate his worship or the prophet’s warning in the valley.

“Amaziah’s Victory Over Edom” says he led his troops to the valley, but its cited passage, 2 Kings 14:7, does not say that. Add 2 Chronicles 25:11 to the citation. The capture of Sela is a separate event, not established as happening in the valley.
“Garrisons” and “became subject to David” may be difficult at a 5th-grade reading level. Consider “stationed soldiers” and “came under David’s rule.”
